component_controls.callback_scope: Actual production recurrent_compute invoked by two std::thread workers, with a start rendezvous only in the test harness. This does not establish the ggml scheduler actual worker count; genuine-model routing checks remain required.

avx2-tile4.asm.caveat: The compiled function materializes/reloads accumulator arrays after the completed dot loop for its generic full/partial gate-store handling. This is once per row group/panel, not per k iteration.

avx512-tile8.asm.caveat: The compiled function materializes/reloads accumulator arrays after the completed dot loop for its generic full/partial gate-store handling. This is once per row group/panel, not per k iteration.

numeric_checks.feedback_oracle: Independent float64 bidirectional LSTM with original input/recurrent weights and nonzero biases
numeric_checks.guards: All matrix, packing and feedback output guards and immutable input bytes checked
numeric_checks.matrix_oracle: NumPy float64 X @ W.T using original unpermuted inputs
numeric_checks.maximum_observed_errors: Not separately emitted by this bounded test; every entry is asserted against the recorded independent bounds.
numeric_checks.nonfinite_products: NaN and positive infinity remain visible at expected gates

component_controls.risk: F32 increasing-k FMA reduction differs from CBLAS. Original-reference model gates and fresh uninstrumented paired performance qualification remain mandatory.
component_controls.scope: Checkpoint-free arithmetic, packing, feedback, concurrent production-callback and O3 code-generation controls. No model inference, microbenchmark or throughput qualification.

implementation_scope.dispatch: Runtime-guarded AVX512F/DQ+AVX2+FMA with 8-row groups, or AVX2+FMA with 4-row groups; partial groups retain specialized SIMD gate products.
implementation_scope.fallbacks: Existing GPU, unsupported ISA, no-BLAS and explicit scalar-LSTM routes remain; original GGUF tensors and exact derived F32 recurrent tensors are retained.
implementation_scope.loop_order: Gate panel outer, then independent worker-owned batch groups; H512 panel is 32 KiB instead of streaming the full 4 MiB matrix for every row group.
implementation_scope.memory_scope: Model-owned immutable cache payload, not total process/graph peak memory; graphs and scheduler are destroyed before packed and original derived weight caches.
implementation_scope.packing: Original F32 W_hh[4H,H] is copied bit-for-bit into [ceil(4H/16),H,16]; only an incomplete gate panel is zero padded. Validated model widths need no padding.
implementation_scope.precision: F32 coefficients, products, accumulation and state. Increasing-k explicit FMA changes dot-product reduction order relative to CBLAS; exact original bias grouping and activation/state equations are retained. No global fast-math or reduced-precision arithmetic.
implementation_scope.threading: Workers own disjoint complete batch recurrences in both directions; private hidden/cell/gate state, no inner BLAS call, provider mutation, per-step worker barrier or product allocation.

limitations: Raw 0.25-second, 12-frame probes do not exercise the complete 24-second overlapping chunk/shift pipeline.
The original-reference gates, provenance, stage inventory and quantization policies are unchanged.
New matrix reduction order can change result bytes; component AVX2/AVX512 and worker-count bit identity does not imply bit identity with CBLAS or original PyTorch.

The configured native thread budget is 2. Model logs directly record packed worker-zero partitions, not an ith1 trace. Actual concurrent production-callback ownership was separately checked with two std::thread workers, not a ggml scheduling trace.
BENCH=1 provides routing and diagnostic spans only. No component, instrumented span or unpaired observation establishes performance.
Actual mapped DSO records describe endpoint main-link-map files, not every relocation binding or transient mapping.
Prior failed full small campaigns remain failed. A fresh committed full qualification is mandatory.

operations: encode float32 WAV without resampling or gain adjustment

original_reference.quantization_scope: Existing restored models are reused and byte-bound to their restoration receipt. The existing restoration quantizer is identified; no conversion or quantization is run here.

avx2-tile4.note: Accumulator stack stores/reloads outside the reduction loop are present; this records no per-k spill, not an absence of all stack traffic.

avx512-tile8.note: Accumulator stack stores/reloads outside the reduction loop are present; this records no per-k spill, not an absence of all stack traffic.

production_codegen.scope: Read-only inspection of the actual production O3 SCNet object, not a new compilation, numerical control, inference or throughput measurement.

raw_checks.execution_entrypoint: Exported scnet_diff in the actual built validation library; same function/arguments as scnet-probe.

loaded_runtime.scope: Current process main ELF link map; file-backed DSO identities, not relocation-binding proof. The main executable and anonymous/JIT mappings are outside this inventory.

packed_recurrence.scope: The log directly observes packed mode and worker-zero counters. With batch>1 and scratch capacity ceil(batch/2), a clamped one-worker invocation would require two blocks and double these counters. Thread=2 configuration, these counters, full outputs and the separate 12 concurrent callback controls jointly support two-worker routing; this is not a direct ith=1 trace.

route_proof.packing_count_expectation: For this genuine12-frame raw geometry,33 packed plus18 pointwise convolution products and24 total concats, derived from the frozen general128MiB selector before observing results.
route_proof.proof_note: Each DP block has two joined input projections and two output projections (four BLAS MUL_MAT calls rather than six); both recurrent nodes consume their views. Feature callbacks invoke the source-bound paired FFT helper, with an ordinary transform for an odd tail.

runtime.observation_scope: Each packed timer is the worker-zero partition only. Its GEMM/gate spans overlap another worker and are not summed or treated as whole-node wall duration. The scheduler graph-node timer measures the complete operation; direct ith1 tracing is absent from these model probes.

scope: Immutable packed F32 recurrence: component and compiler controls plus six 0.25-second raw probes against original F32 reference captures. No full default-pipeline or performance qualification.

source_binding.candidate_status: Packed runtime changes are identified by exact compiled source hashes; they are not attributed to either earlier parent commit. C3 had not yet been checkpointed when these controls ran.
